text-to-handwriting.formula:
lineHeight = fontSize x 1.7
canvasHeight = padding x 2 + lines x lineHeight
words wrapped by canvas.measureText to fit the page width
howTo: Type or paste your text into the box.
Choose a handwriting style: classic, casual or elegant.
Pick an ink color and adjust the text size.
Toggle ruled notebook paper on or off.
Press Download to save your note as a PNG image.
keyFacts: Text is rendered on a canvas with your device's script fonts.
The page looks like a notebook: cream paper, blue lines, red margin.
Long text wraps automatically and the page grows taller.
The PNG downloads at full canvas resolution.
Everything runs locally; no text is uploaded.

Input: "Hello World"
Style: Classic, ink: blue (#1e3a8a), size: 48px, ruled paper ON.
Step 1: line height = 48 x 1.7 = 81.6 -> 82px
Step 2: "Hello World" fits on one wrapped line
Step 3: page height = 120 + 1 x 82 + 20 = 222px (1240px wide)
Step 4: cream background, blue ruled lines and red margin are drawn, then the text in blue script font
